title_as_printed: Isopiestic data for the system: potassium chloride (B) - calcium chloride (C)

footnotes_as_printed.*: Not used in computing values of beta_0 in eq (26).

value.what: molality of CaCl2 in the mixed KCl-CaCl2 solution in isopiestic equilibrium

value2.what: molality of the KCl reference solution; printed once per block, filled down

phi.what: osmotic coefficient of the mixed solution, computed by the authors from the reference molality

composition.other_species: none; rows with empty m_B are pure CaCl2 solutions (dotted line printed in the m_B column)

extra_unmapped: phi(calc.) (osmotic coefficient from the authors' fitted equations; empty where printed as dotted line)
notes: The printed table has two column groups side by side (sets 1-6 left, sets 6-10 right); the right group is stacked after the left. Set 6 continues across the two groups: M_B 2.9689 block has rows 2.4640 and 1.5330 (left) followed by 0.6726 and the pure CaCl2 row (right). Set and M_B are printed once per block and filled down. Rows with a * on m_B (footnote) are flagged in the note column as m_B:*. Dotted entries in phi(calc.) mean no calculated value and are written empty; the dotted m_B means no KCl (pure CaCl2) and is written empty. Blocks with no pure CaCl2 row printed: set 1 M_B 0.7577, set 3 M_B 1.5240, sets 4 (2.0809), 5, 6 (2.9694), 7 (3.4262), 8 (3.7176), 9 (4.3543), 10 (4.6201).
